walkthrough:
**Spot what the question wants**

Read the stem carefully. It asks for the comparison that is not correct. That means three rows are true biology, and one row has a mistake. That mistaken row is our answer.

**Check rows A, B and C**

Prokaryotic DNA is naked and circular, not wrapped around histones, while plant nuclear DNA is linear and wrapped around histones. Prokaryotes have no membrane-bound organelles like endoplasmic reticulum, plants do. Bacterial walls are peptidoglycan (murein), plant walls are cellulose. So A, B and C are all correct comparisons.

**Examine row D about ribosomes**

It is true that prokaryotic 70S ribosomes are about $18 \text{ nm}$ in diameter and eukaryotic cytoplasmic 80S ribosomes are about $22 \text{ nm}$ in diameter. The mistake is the word all.

A plant cell also has mitochondria and chloroplasts, and these organelles contain smaller 70S ribosomes, about $18 \text{ nm}$, just like prokaryotes. So it is wrong to say all plant ribosomes are $22 \text{ nm}$.

options.A: This is a correct comparison, so it is not the answer. Prokaryotic DNA is not associated with histones, plant nuclear DNA is.
options.B: This is a correct comparison, so it is not the answer. Prokaryotes lack ER as they have no membrane-bound organelles, plant cells have ER.
options.C: This is a correct comparison, so it is not the answer. Bacteria typically have peptidoglycan walls, plants have cellulose walls.
options.D: This is the not correct comparison. Plant cells do not have only 22 nm ribosomes, they also have smaller 18 nm 70S ribosomes in mitochondria and chloroplasts.
